caption: The drawing depicts a sculptural object resembling a candlestick or decorative stand. It features a base composed of three rectangular tiers, each decreasing in size as they ascend. Emerging from the base is a fish with stylized features, such as a large circular eye, open mouth, textured scales, and a prominent dorsal fin. The fish curves upward in an arc. At the top of the fish, the structure transitions into an ornate holder or support featuring two layers of flared, petal-like elements, possibly designed to hold a candle or similar object. The entire composition is rendered in shades of blue and blue-violet, with shading and highlights indicating the form and contours of the design. The background is plain and unadorned.
title: Dolphin Candlestick
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
